description.fun: Treecko is unflappable: it never panics, even when facing a much bigger foe, and it fiercely guards the tall trees where it nests. The tiny spikes on its feet let it walk straight up walls, and its two-lobed tail senses humidity well enough to forecast tomorrow's weather. It even twitches its feet in its sleep, apparently dreaming of climbing. A real spider species is named after it.
description.guide: A small Grass-type gecko Pokémon and one of Hoenn's three first partners. It climbs walls with spiny feet, senses humidity with its tail and calmly defends the trees of its forest home. It evolves into Grovyle and then Sceptile.
description.tagline: A cool-headed gecko that climbs walls and forecasts the weather

description.fun: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch so quickly that no Pokémon has ever caught one running away, and its leaves camouflage it so well that even veteran researchers struggle to find one asleep. It looks like a small raptor dinosaur, perhaps a feathered one, with leaves in place of plumage. Like Treecko and Sceptile, it has a spider species named after it.
description.guide: A Grass-type Pokémon, the middle stage of the Treecko line, resembling a small theropod dinosaur with leaves on its arms, head and tail. It lives in forests and jungles, where it leaps between branches. It evolves into Sceptile at level 36.
description.tagline: A leaf-feathered raptor that no one has ever caught on the run

description.fun: Sceptile is the unrivalled master of jungle combat: the leaves on its arms can slice through thick trees, yet it lovingly tends the forest, and the seeds along its back carry nutrients said to revive trees, even helping saplings grow while it sleeps. Its name blends sceptre, for the 'forest king', with reptile. Its Mega Evolution arrived in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire.
description.guide: A Grass-type Pokémon, the final form of Treecko: a tall gecko with blade-like leaves on its arms and nutrient-filled seeds on its back. It is said to have no equal in jungle combat. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Sceptile.
description.tagline: The jungle's blade-armed king, who tends the trees it could cut

description.fun: Mega Evolution fills the seeds on Sceptile's back with energy, and it can detonate them to fire the spiky tip of its tail at foes like a missile, regrowing it for as long as the Mega Evolution lasts. Its fast legs carry it to an opponent in a flash.
